plan.archetype: Multi-hit attacks with Dexterity scaling and Weak
plan.bossPrep: Use repeated hits to strip Slippery. Upgrade efficient damage and Neutralize; secure strong block for turn-three Dismember and carry defensive potions.
plan.summary: Take efficient attacks early, then add scaling and reliable defense. Remove surplus starters, avoid speculative combos, and fight elites only with adequate health and damage.
